mapper.select: SELECT arid, stock_code AS stockCode, bsns_year AS bsnsYear, reprt_code AS reprtCode, content, model, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_report WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND bsns_year = #{bsnsYear} AND reprt_code = #{reprtCode}

SELECT arid, stock_code AS stockCode, bsns_year AS bsnsYear, reprt_code AS reprtCode, model, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_report WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY bsns_year DESC, reprt_code DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_report (stock_code, bsns_year, reprt_code, content, model) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{bsnsYear}, #{reprtCode}, #{content}, #{model}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content = VALUES(content), model = VALUES(model)
